transcript.en: We've been discussing the factors the architect has to consider when designing domestic buildings.
transcript.zh: 我们之前一直在讨论建筑师在设计住宅时必须考虑的因素。

transcript.en: I'm going to move on now to consider the design of public buildings,
transcript.zh: 现在我要继续来讲设计公共建筑时要考虑的因素，

transcript.en: and I'll illustrate this by referring to the new Taylor Concert Hall that's recently been completed here in the city.
transcript.zh: 我会以市里最近建成的新Taylor Concert Hall为例说明这些因素。

transcript.en: So, as with a domestic building, when designing a public building,
transcript.zh: 和设计住宅一样，建筑师在设计一栋公共建筑时，

transcript.en: an architect needs to consider the function of the building - for example, is it to be used primarily for entertainment,
transcript.zh: 需要考虑到这栋建筑的功能，比如它是主要用来休闲娱乐的，

transcript.en: or for education, or for administration?
transcript.zh: 还是用于教育或者管理？

transcript.en: The second thing the architect needs to think about is the context of the building,
transcript.zh: 建筑师需要考虑的第二件事就是这栋建筑的来龙去脉，

transcript.en: this includes its physical location, obviously, but it also includes the social meaning of the building,
transcript.zh: 包括很明显的一点--它的实际位置，还有这栋建筑的社会意义，

transcript.en: how it relates to the people it's built for.
transcript.zh: 即它和使用这栋建筑的人群之间有什么联系。

transcript.en: And finally, for important public buildings,
transcript.zh: 最后一点，对于很重要的公共建筑，

transcript.en: the architect may also be looking for a central symbolic idea on which to base the design,
transcript.zh: 建筑师也许还要寻找一个代表性的中心思想，以此作为设计的基础，

transcript.en: a sort of metaphor for the building and the way in which it is used.
transcript.zh: 有点像这栋建筑和它的用途的比喻。

transcript.en: Let's look at the new Taylor Concert Hall in relation to these ideas.
transcript.zh: 我们来看看新Taylor Concert Hall的设计中与这些想法相关的地方。

transcript.en: The location chosen was a site in a run-down district that has been ignored in previous redevelopment plans.
transcript.zh: 它选址于一个破败的地区，这个地区在之前的再开发计划中被忽视了。

transcript.en: It was occupied by a factory that had been empty for some years.
transcript.zh: 这个地点曾经是一座空了好几年的工厂。

transcript.en: The whole area was some distance from the high-rise office blocks of the central business district and shopping centre,
transcript.zh: 整个地区离中心商业区的高层办公大楼和购物中心都有一段距离，

transcript.en: but it was only one kilometre from the ring road.
transcript.zh: 但是距环城路仅一千米。

transcript.en: "The site itself was bordered to the north by a canal which had once been used by boats bringing in raw materials when the area was used for manufacturing.
transcript.zh: Taylor Concert Hall所在地点的北部被一条运河包围着，在该地区过去从事制造业的时候，这条河曾被用作船只运来原材料的通道。"

transcript.en: The architect chosen for the project was Tom Harrison.
transcript.zh: 被选定设计这个项目的建筑师是Tom Harrison。

transcript.en: He found the main design challenge was the location of the site in an area that had no neighbouring buildings of any importance.
transcript.zh: 他发现这次设计的主要挑战就是这一地点的地理位置，这个区域内没有任何重要的邻近建筑。

transcript.en: To reflect the fact that the significance of the building in this quite run-down location
transcript.zh: 为了反映出这栋身处如此破败地区的建筑的重要性那时

transcript.en: was as yet unknown, he decided to create a building centred around the idea of a mystery - something whose meaning still has to be discovered.
transcript.zh: 仍未为人所知这一事实，他决定以谜团这个想法为中心设计出一栋建筑，而这个“谜团”的意思至今仍待探索。

transcript.en: So how was this reflected in the design of the building?
transcript.zh: 那么，这一点在这栋建筑的设计中是如何体现的呢？

transcript.en: Well, Harrison decided to create pedestrian access to the building and to make use of the presence of water on the site.
transcript.zh: Harrison决定造一条通往建筑的步行通道，并且充分利用这里的运河。

transcript.en: As people approach the entrance, they therefore have to cross over a bridge.
transcript.zh: 因此如果人们想要走近入口，他们就得穿过一座桥。

transcript.en: He wanted to give people a feeling of suspense as they see the building first from a distance,
transcript.zh: 他希望，随着人们最初从远处看见这栋建筑，

transcript.en: and then close-up, and the initial impression he wanted to create from the shape of the building as a whole was that of a box.
transcript.zh: 然后慢慢接近的过程中会产生一种悬念，他想通过这整栋建筑的外形给人们留下的最初印象是一个盒子。

transcript.en: The first side that people see, the southern wall, is just a high, flat wall uninterrupted by any windows.
transcript.zh: 人们看到的第一面是这栋建筑南边的墙，这个墙只是一堵又高又平，没有任何窗户的墙。

transcript.en: "This might sound off-putting, but it supports Harrison's concept of the building - that the person approaching is intrigued and wonders what will be inside.
transcript.zh: 这听起来也许有点扫兴，但它支持着Harrison对这栋建筑的设计概念不断走近的人会被激起兴趣，好奇里面是什么。"

transcript.en: And this flat wall also has another purpose.
transcript.zh: 这堵平坦的墙还有另一个用途。

transcript.en: At night-time, projectors are switched on and it functions as a huge screen, onto which images are projected.
transcript.zh: 晚上的时候，他们会打开投影仪，而这堵墙就被用作了一块巨大的屏幕，投影仪会把图像投影在上面。

transcript.en: The auditorium itself seats 1500 people.
transcript.zh: 大礼堂本身可容纳1500位观众。

transcript.en: The floor's supported by ten massive pads.
transcript.zh: 地面由十张厚重的软垫支撑。

transcript.en: These are constructed from rubber,
transcript.zh: 这些软垫都是由橡胶制成的，

transcript.en: and so are able to absorb any vibrations from outside and prevent them from affecting the auditorium.
transcript.zh: 可以吸收来自外界的所有振动，防止它们影响礼堂内的活动。

transcript.en: The walls are made of several layers of honey-coloured wood, all sourced from local beech trees.
transcript.zh: 墙面是用好几层蜜色木板做成的，这些木板都取材于当地的山毛榉树。

transcript.en: In order to improve the acoustic properties of the auditorium and to amplify the sound,
transcript.zh: 为了改善大礼堂的声学特性，放大音量，

transcript.en: they are not straight, they are curved.
transcript.zh: 他们把这些木板做成了曲面而不是直面。

transcript.en: The acoustics are also adjustable according to the size of orchestra and the type of music being played.
transcript.zh: 根据管弦乐队的规模和演奏的音乐种类，音响效果也能够加以调整。

transcript.en: In order to achieve this,
transcript.zh: 为了做到这一点

transcript.en: there are nine movable panels in the ceiling above the orchestra which are all individually motorized,
transcript.zh: 他们在乐队位置上方的天花板上安装了九个可移动的嵌板，这些全都是单独机动控制的。

transcript.en: and the walls also have curtains which can be opened or closed to change the acoustics.
transcript.zh: 墙上还装了帘子，可以通过拉开合拢来改变音响效果。

transcript.en: The reaction of the public to the new building has generally been positive.
transcript.zh: 大众对这栋新建筑的反应总体上都比较积极。

transcript.en: However, the evaluation of some critics has been less enthusiastic.
transcript.zh: 然而一些批评家的评估却没有那么热情。

transcript.en: In spite of Harrison's efforts to use local materials,
transcript.zh: 即使Harrison尽量都从当地取材，

transcript.en: they criticise the style of the design as being international rather than local,
transcript.zh: 他们还是认为这栋建筑的设计风格更国际化而不符合当地特色，

transcript.en: and say it doesn't reflect features of the landscape or society for which it is built.
transcript.zh: 还说它没有反映出这栋建筑所在的地形特色和它服务的社会的特点。
